== Roster ==
Fictional club, real structure. Mirrors the markup Brazilian season articles
actually use, so the parser is tested against the shapes that broke it:
abbr-wrapped headers, one cell per line, wikilinked positions, flagicon
nationalities, birth date and age2, and a {{sort}} template whose closing braces
look like a table terminator.
{{updated|9 September 2026}}
